horizon.pages.settings.tooltip: Horizon's own settings: graphics, controllers, extras and mods.
horizon.pages.graphics.tooltip: Graphics, simply: each setting says what it costs.
horizon.pages.graphics_advanced.tooltip: Every graphics setting, Horizon's included, with what each costs.
horizon.pages.controller.tooltip: Controllers: their buttons, sticks, vibration and menu navigation.
horizon.pages.extras.tooltip: Optional additions, all off by default: the game stays vanilla until you turn one on.
horizon.pages.agent.tooltip: Let your own AI agent play: horizon-ctl and MCP clients on this computer.
horizon.pages.split_profiles.tooltip: Who plays: a profile kept in this game folder.
horizon.pages.shader_packs.tooltip: Shader packs from the shaderpacks folder: Horizon's own and those in the shaders/ format. One runs at a time.
horizon.pages.mods.tooltip: Mods made for Horizon, from the horizon-mods folder. Each runs in a sandbox and stays off until you turn it on.
horizon.mods.empty: No mods: put .hmod files in the horizon-mods folder
horizon.shader_packs.empty: No shader packs: put them in the shaderpacks folder

Size of menus and the HUD.

Soft shadows in corners. Costs chunk bui: Soft shadows in corners. Costs chunk building time only.
Smaller copies of block textures for dis: Smaller copies of block textures for distant terrain: less shimmer.

horizon.multiplayer.not_signed_in: This server is in online mode. Sign in with your Microsoft account in the Horizon launcher to join it.
horizon.multiplayer.connected_friend_rel: Connected to your friend through the relay...
horizon.touch.editor.hint: Tap a control to set it up · drag to move it · pinch with a second finger to resize
horizon.touch.editor.save_failed: Could not save the layout. Tap Done to try again.
horizon.touch.editor.status_auto_always: Auto: in game and in menus
horizon.touch.editor.where_hint: Auto follows the control scheme and touch settings.
horizon.touch.editor.where_hint_menu: In menus: over the inventory, chests and the pause menu. Auto shows it in game, and in the inventory when “Controls in inventory” is on.
horizon.touch.editor.opacity_all: Use this opacity for every control
horizon.touch.editor.label: Label
horizon.touch.editor.keys_hint: Up to four keys, pressed together in this order (for example Ctrl + Q).
horizon.touch.editor.swipe_hint: A finger sliding from one such button to another presses it, without lifting.
horizon.touch.editor.list_layer_game: Shown in game now. Tap a control to set it up; the eye shows or hides it.
horizon.touch.editor.list_layer_menus: Shown over menus now. Tap a control to set it up; the eye shows or hides it.
horizon.touch.editor.keys_physical: Or press a key on a connected keyboard.
horizon.touch.editor.scheme: This layout belongs to the scheme “%s”. Each scheme keeps its own positions.
horizon.touch.editor.snap_hint: Dragged controls line up on an 8 dp grid. They always snap to other controls' edges and centres.
horizon.touch.editor.copy_schemes_hint: The other control schemes get these positions and sizes.
horizon.touch.editor.reset_text: Controls of this scheme go back to their places and sizes, hidden ones come back. Your own buttons stay but move to free space. Undo can bring it back.
horizon.touch.utility.more.name: Key drawer (...)
horizon.touch.utility.mouse.name: Menu mouse
horizon.touch.utility.back.name: Back
horizon.touch.utility.lmb.name: Left mouse button
horizon.touch.utility.rmb.name: Right mouse button
horizon.touch.editor.utility_hint.more: Opens F3, F5, chat, the keyboard and more keys.
horizon.touch.editor.utility_hint.mouse: Turns the virtual mouse on over screens.
horizon.touch.editor.utility_hint.back: Closes the open screen, like Esc.
horizon.touch.editor.utility_hint.lmb: Shown over screens while the virtual mouse is on.
horizon.touch.editor.utility_hint.rmb: Shown over screens while the virtual mouse is on.
horizon.options.graphics_api.android: Selected in Horizon Android launcher > Setup.
horizon.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
horizon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
horizon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
horizon.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Rejoins a server after a lost connection or a restart, never after a kick or ban.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers the held item, Shift + left-drag moves every slot.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
horizon.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
horizon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
horizon.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Hides and turns off every AI feature: agent control, horizon-ctl and the MCP servers. The launcher's switch too.
horizon.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Your own AI agent can play this game through horizon-ctl or an MCP client, on this computer only.
horizon.extras.discord_presence.tooltip: Shows Playing Horizon on your Discord profile while Discord runs: menus, single player or multiplayer, the dimension and the time played. Never a world's name or a server's address.
horizon.agent.status.off: Off: agents can't reach this game.
horizon.agent.status.session: Opened for this session by the program that started the game.
horizon.agent.status.socket: Socket: %s (copy the details for its full path)
horizon.agent.status.local: Local only: agents on this computer, never the network.
horizon.mods.not_built.tooltip: Installed, not built into this game: build the game with it in the launcher (Settings > Native mods), then play the instance that build is in.
horizon.mods.capability.game: see your position, health and the time
horizon.mods.capability.storage: save its own settings to disk
horizon.mods.capability.command: run commands as you, with your permissions
horizon.mods.capability.registries: add blocks, items, mob effects and entity types to your worlds
horizon.mods.capability.ui: show its own screens and a settings page
horizon.mods.capability.render: draw on your screen, shake and zoom the camera
horizon.mods.capability.input: see the keys you hold and your clicks, take over the use button on its own items and the mouse wheel, and add keys
horizon.mods.capability.players: see who is on the server and message them
horizon.mods.capability.world: read and change the world's blocks
horizon.mods.capability.recipes: read the game's recipes and items and which recipes you know, place recipes in your crafting grid and, in creative mode, give you items
Sets the three below full screen, one te: Sets the three below full screen, one test picture at a time.
A key that opens this screen from the ga: A key that opens this screen from the game. Not bound at first.
Keeps fine plants in high-res packs from: Keeps fine plants in high-res packs from fading far away.
F2 screenshots at this many times the ga: F2 screenshots at this many times the game's resolution. Higher takes longer.
Reuses the pack shadow map when sun, vie: Reuses the pack shadow map when sun, view and world match. Off by default.
Your display didn't say how bright it ge: Your display didn't say how bright it gets: calibrate to set it up.
Already set up for your display. Only ca: Already set up for your display. Only calibrate if HDR looks wrong.
Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White bac: Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White back to your display's setup.
Set up for your display. Leave on Auto u: Set up for your display. Leave on Auto unless it looks wrong.
Lower it until the logo just disappears: Lower it until the logo just disappears into the black.
Raise it until the logo just disappears: Raise it until the logo just disappears into the bright square.
Make the card a white that's comfortable: Make the card a white that's comfortable to look at for a long time, in the light you play in.
horizon.mod.smartf3.move_up: Move up (%1$s of %3$s in the %4$s column)
horizon.mod.smartf3.move_down: Move down (%1$s of %3$s in the %4$s column)
horizon.mod.smartf3.move_up_end: Move up (already first in the %s column)
horizon.mod.smartf3.move_down_end: Move down (already last in the %s column)
horizon.friends.title: Play with Friends
horizon.friends.hint: Friends paste the code after the title screen's Friends button, in Direct Connection, or on the launcher's Play page.
horizon.friends.intro: Share this world behind an invite code: it opens to LAN, and friends on the internet join with the code. No server of ours is involved.
horizon.friends.finding: Finding how friends can reach you…
horizon.friends.code_changed: Someone kept trying a wrong short code, so it changed.
horizon.friends.ready: Your invite code is ready: Game Menu, Play with Friends. Copy it and send it to your friends.
horizon.friends.reach.relay_only: Friends join through the relay only.
horizon.friends.reach.mapped: Friends anywhere can join: your router opened the port with %s.
horizon.friends.reach.public: Friends anywhere can join: this computer has a public address (TCP port %s must not be blocked by a firewall).
horizon.friends.reach.cgnat: Friends on your network or VPN can join. From the internet they can't: your router is itself behind another NAT (your provider's carrier-grade NAT, CGNAT, or a second router), so opening its port isn't enough. Use a relay or a VPN such as Tailscale or ZeroTier.
horizon.friends.reach.local: Friends on your network or VPN can join. For friends on the internet: turn on UPnP on your router, or %s, or use a relay, or a VPN such as Tailscale or ZeroTier (the code already holds your VPN address).
horizon.touch.editor.layouts_empty: No saved layouts yet. Save this one to switch back to it any time.
horizon.touch.editor.layouts_hint: ✓ puts a layout on the screen, the arrow saves the current one over it. Each keeps all three control schemes, your buttons and what shows where.
horizon.touch.editor.code_hint: A layout code is one line of text: send it to a friend in a chat, and they paste it here to get your layout.
horizon.touch.editor.delete_layout_text: The saved layout “%s” will be deleted. The controls on the screen stay as they are.
horizon.touch.editor.pasted: Layout pasted. Undo takes it back.
horizon.touch.editor.paste_failed: The clipboard holds no layout code.
horizon.touch.editor.loaded: Layout on the screen. Undo takes it back.
horizon.touch.editor.copied: Layout code copied. Paste it in a chat or a note.
